subject: The secret mistake 92% of couples make
preview_text: It's not about finding new date ideas. It's about avoiding this one trap that kills the spark. I discovered it too late.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I built SoulPlan because my own relationship hit a wall. We had the same dinner, same movie, same silence. The spark wasn't gone, it was just... buried under routine. And the biggest mistake? Thinking new ideas alone would fix it.

Here's the truth we discovered from 230+ couples: the magic isn't just in the 'new.' It's in the 'surprise.' The deliberate, 'I was thinking of you' gesture that breaks the autopilot. That's the hack to avoid the routine trap. It tells your partner they're worth the effort, not just the routine.

We noticed you haven't tried the Surprise Date Planner yet. This is the feature that lets one partner secretly plan everything—the AI suggests ideas based on your partner's interests, you pick, and they just get a notification to get ready. All the 'I wonder what we'll do?' excitement, none of the planning stress for them.

Don't let another weekend slip into the usual. Plan one surprise. It takes 2 minutes. Open SoulPlan, tap 'Surprise Date,' and pick something that says 'I'm paying attention.' P.S. The couples who use this feature once are 3x more likely to keep the app. They told us it feels like dating again.
